mapper.sql: menu_id, menu_name, category, avg_rating, bookmark_cnt, regdate
mapper.select: select from tbl_menu order by menu_name asc, menu_id asc

select m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.category, m.avg_rating, m.regdate, (select count(*) from tbl_bookmark b where b.menu_id = m.menu_id) as bookmark_cnt, case when exists (select 1 from tbl_bookmark b where b.menu_id = m.menu_id and b.userid = #{userid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) then 1 else 0 end as bookmarked from tbl_menu m where category = #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by menu_name asc, menu_id asc
select count(*) from tbl_menu where category = #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.category, m.avg_rating, (select count(*) from tbl_bookmark b2 where b2.menu_id = m.menu_id) as bookmark_cnt, 1 as bookmarked, b.regdate as regdate from tbl_bookmark b join tbl_menu m on m.menu_id = b.menu_id where b.userid = #{userid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by b.regdate desc, b.bookmark_id desc
